title: IN WHICH PHILEAS FOGG SHOWS HIMSELF EQUAL TO THE OCCASION
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg takes over the Henrietta, burns its wooden parts for fuel, reaches Ireland, and is arrested upon arriving in Liverpool.
summary_detail: Phileas Fogg bribes the crew of the Henrietta to lock up Captain Speedy and sail toward Liverpool. When the coal supply runs low, Fogg buys the ship at a premium and burns its wooden fixtures to keep the steam going. Reaching Ireland, Fogg's party takes a train to Dublin and a fast steamer to Liverpool, only for Fix to finally arrest Fogg just as they disembark.
